'''Sesayap Tidong''' or '''Northern Tidung''' is one of several [[Sabahan language]]s of [[Sabah]], [[Malaysia]], spoken by the [[Tidong people]]. It retains the system of [[Austronesian alignment]] that has been lost by [[Southern Tidung language|Southern Tidung]] in [[Kalimantan]], [[Indonesia]].
